text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O gets injured during training, so I bring her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sorry… This is all because I was so careless…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I took notes on how this injury occurred, and I'll make sure it doesn't happen again…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wonder if they ever have students fill out questionnaires about how they were injured. I bet the results would make a good reference.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All right, let's return to training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm still in a little bit of pain, but it shouldn't affect my running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Plus, I can't simply sit around while others are out there training!
choice_data_list: I understand how you feel, but you should still rest.
Okay. Let's see what you can do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: In other words, patience is a virtue…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll rest for today and make sure my injury heals.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I got myself into this mess, so please don't feel bad about this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O looks crestfallen as she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hngh… Now it hurts even more…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um… Maybe I should stop after all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O looks full of regret as she returns to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whew… I don't think I can exactly run, but I'll find some kind of training to do regardless!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Having a positive attitude is the fastest way to heal injuries! "Running is the best medicine," as the saying goes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we continue training. Mindful of her injury, Sakura Chiyono O sticks to what she can do safely.
